title: Correct both quadrature and proposal-rate changes
statement: For t=beta/2,h_i=|b_i|+sum_j|Jij|,h=max h_i,W=2t(sum|b|+sum|J|),G=t sumGamma,T0=W+2G+n,choose M0>=max(2,m_struct/2,3th,2tGamma_max,6thT0),Delta=t/M0,Gamma_i+=Gamma_i(1+2h_iDelta). For each reconstructed half-path I-Q=sum_j deltaV_j(midcell(tau_j)-tau_j),|I-Q|<=Delta sum_i h_i N_i. rho_i=log(1+2h_iDelta)>=h_iDelta yields acceptance exp(I-Q-sum rho_iNi)<=1. Product over TWOhalfpaths restores squared continuum kernel using unnormalized Dyson weights;no extra Poisson factor. Kernel domination gives acceptance>=e^-1 uniformly over supported filters/prefixes. Zero/tiny rates use explicit parity-conditioned branches. Grid fixed by physical/structural parameters,not requested receiver accuracy.
